description: Hi everyone! We are a core team of tech enthusiasts and builders coming straight from UAI Club. As an AI-focused crew, we combine deep technical execution with creative product thinking to solve complex real-world problems. For the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are tackling Challenge #12: Planet X and SPHEREx—building an interactive cosmic transient hunter that transforms NASA's infrared sky maps into an engaging web app where anyone can discover moving celestial bodies!
